increments.title: Solar/Umbral Eclipse mana reaction
increments.note: Opposing original affinities trigger one bounded Eclipse bonus hit and clear the primed affinity; same/None applications do not fabricate reactions.

increments.title: Earned combo finisher
increments.note: Standard play arms one finisher after three successful combo hits; out-of-range rejection preserves it and successful use consumes it.

increments.title: Accessible combo-assist preset
increments.note: Opt-in Accessible lowers only the finisher threshold from three hits to two and persists through training-session resets; Standard remains default.

increments.title: Deterministic training encounter grade
increments.note: Lincoln completion records Gold at <=3 seconds, Silver at <=6 seconds, otherwise Bronze, using combat-domain elapsed time.

increments.title: National Mall objective-completion reward
increments.note: The existing free-discovery landmark chain grants one capped completion resource reward when all three objectives are satisfied; repeats cannot farm it.

increments.title: Clean completed-encounter retry
increments.note: Retry restores transient combat/Shadowblade attempt state and immediately re-enters the encounter, preserves the defense timing preset, and preserves the one-time completion reward ledger.

research.community_limit: Historical individual retry-friction reports, not consensus and not proof of current comparator behavior.

verification.fixture_limit: Exact modified sources plus a minimal test-only interface for unchanged Shadowblade dependency; not a full repository or native Windows run.

next_action: Open the pass-3 PR, require real hosted Windows and release-manifest checks plus exact-head independent Codex review, then merge only if all gates are green.
